title: mtDNA haplogroup tree (PhyloTree 17)
description: The human mitochondrial phylogeny: which mutations define each maternal-line haplogroup, relative to the rCRS reference. Used to find the haplogroup that best matches the mitochondrial calls on a chip.
licence: PhyloTree Build 17 (van Oven 2016), packaged by HaploGrep under MIT

source.name: PhyloTree Build 17 rCRS, HaploGrep tree release 17.3

citation: van Oven M. PhyloTree Build 17: Growing the human mitochondrial DNA tree. Forensic Sci Int Genet Suppl Ser 2015;5:e392–e394; Schönherr S et al. Haplogrep 3. Nucleic Acids Res. 2023
